I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from Priyanka's 3 Sep 2025 posts in that channel. At 14:06 she said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she said Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

None of the channels or files Tobias can see give an address or any other location for Southgate, so I suggested he check with Priyanka before the call. I only read the incident channel, #central-team and the public files, and he's a member of both channels. I didn't use search_messages.
